## Changes made from the upstream version

Modified by SkillOffice on 2026-11-06:

- Rewrote in SkillOffice format; the body is now about 90 lines with asset structures moved to `references/asset-structures.md`.
- Kept the core principles, "claims sellers can defend", and the structures for decks, one-pagers, objection documents, demo scripts, ROI calculators, case study briefs, proposals, playbooks and persona cards.
- Moved battle cards, live deal objections and win-loss analysis to sls-competitive-battlecard, sls-objection-handling and sls-win-loss-review.
- Wrote a short, original cold call script structure in place of the upstream reference file.
- Removed the upstream product-marketing context file, tool integration links (including a partner tool) and references to upstream skills not imported.
- Added pricing and terms placeholders that require team approval, a customer-permission flag for names, logos and quotes, SkillOffice context fields, safety and handoff sections.
